texts.question: I bought the annual plan last week by mistake. Can I get my money back?
texts.cheap_draft: Yes. You are within 14 days of buying it, so cancel in Settings > Billing (Cancel plan) and the full amount goes back to your card.
texts.expensive_answer: Yes. Annual plans cancelled within 14 days of purchase are refunded in full to the card you paid with. Open Settings > Billing and choose Cancel plan.

texts.question: How many people can use our account on the Starter plan?
texts.cheap_draft: The Starter plan includes up to 5 users.
texts.expensive_answer: Starter includes up to 3 users. For more, Team allows up to 15 and Business has no limit.

texts.question: Can I pay my subscription by bank transfer instead of card?
texts.cheap_draft: Yes, you can pay by bank transfer. Choose Bank transfer in Settings > Billing and use the reference shown there.
texts.expensive_answer: I could not find payment by bank transfer in our help articles. A member of our team will reply to you.

texts.question: How do I export all my invoices from last year?
texts.cheap_draft: Go to Reports > Invoices, pick last year as the date range and choose Export.
texts.expensive_answer: Open Reports > Invoices, set the date range to last year and choose Export, as CSV or PDF. If there are more than 500 invoices, you get the download link by email.

texts.question: What happens to my invoices if we downgrade from Team to Starter?
texts.cheap_draft: Starter includes up to 3 users, Team up to 15.
texts.expensive_answer: Nothing happens to them: all invoices and clients stay when you move from Team to Starter. Only users beyond 3 lose access, at the end of the billing period.

claims.text: You can switch to annual billing at any time.
Open Settings > Billing and choose annual.
The unused part of this month is credited to the annual price.
You also get 10% off the annual price when you switch.

texts.question: We are on monthly billing. How do we switch to annual and what happens to this month?
texts.cheap_draft: You can switch to annual billing at any time. Open Settings > Billing and choose annual. The unused part of this month is credited to the annual price. You also get 10% off the annual price when you switch. The change applies right away.
texts.expensive_answer: Open Settings > Billing and switch to annual billing; you can do it at any time. The unused part of the current month is credited to the annual price.

texts.question: Can I send invoices to my clients in Spanish?
texts.cheap_draft: Yes. Set Spanish as the invoice language for each client under Clients > Edit > Invoice language.
texts.expensive_answer: Yes, Spanish is supported: choose it per client under Clients > Edit > Invoice language.
